name: stark-law-aks-compliance
description: Drafts counsel's compliance memos and opinions on physician financial relationships under the Stark Law (physician self-referral, 42 U.S.C. 1395nn, 42 C.F.R. 411.350-.389) and the federal Anti-Kickback Statute (42 U.S.C. 1320a-7b(b), 42 C.F.R. 1001.952 safe harbors). Screens for a physician, a designated health services referral and a financial relationship first; tests fair market value, commercial reasonableness and volume or value separately; checks set-in-advance rate changes, 90-day signature rules, holdovers, indirect compensation and stand in the shoes; runs the AKS one-purpose and safe harbor analysis apart from Stark; flags state self-referral and all-payor kickback laws, EKRA, advisory opinion reliance, FCA exposure, the 60-day overpayment rule, and CMS SRDP versus OIG Self-Disclosure Protocol. Covers directorships, employment, leases, co-management and marketing. Routes provider-side operational reviews to conducting-stark-law-analysis and FCA exposure to conducting-false-claims-analysis.
